evidence.title: GitHub - phosphor-icons/react: A flexible icon family for React

name: Phosphor Icons
summary: Icon family with six weights (thin, light, regular, bold, fill, duotone) packaged for React, Vue, Flutter and web fonts.
description: An icon family for interfaces, diagrams and presentations, shipping every icon in six weights as SVG assets and as framework packages: @phosphor-icons/react for tree-shakeable React imports with SSR support, @phosphor-icons/web webfonts loaded weight by weight, plus Vue and Flutter ports. @phosphor-icons/core holds the raw SVGs with catalog data (tags, categories, versions). MIT licensed.
contains: 6 weights: regular, thin, light, bold, fill, duotone
React, Vue and Flutter component packages plus web fonts
tree-shakeable React imports with SSR and RSC support
raw SVG assets and a catalog of tags, categories and versions in @phosphor-icons/core
